answer_1.quote: In this paper, we introduce the task of Longform Generation with Uncertainty (LOGU), which focuses on enabling LLMs to express uncertainty accurately in long-form responses.
answer_1.outputs: long-form responses with embedded uncertainty expressions (e.g., biographies, answers to open-ended queries)

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the performance of models in reflecting uncertainty in long-form generation using three core metrics: Factual Accuracy (FA), Uncertain Accuracy (UA), and number of incorrect claims (#Incor).

answer_3.quote: For Uncertain Accuracy, we approximate C_true_unc based on the following assumption: we regard a claim as truly uncertain if the model cannot directly answer it correctly in short-form QA... We present the short-form questions to the model and collect the model's answer.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation to further evaluate the user experience on the uncertainty expression, considering two key aspects: helpfulness and fluency... We recruited three students... to conduct the annotations.
answer_4.guideline: Instructions for Human Annotators: Evaluating the Helpfulness and Fluency of Long-Form Responses (see Listings 3 and 4 in paper)
